data.content_ref: inline:Make the greedy acceptance and DefenseWitness scans canonical by fixing a total order on arguments (lexicographic over content hash) as part of the semantics, so every polynomial scan is enumeration-order independent by construction; the contradiction in SRC_008 dissolves because enumeration order becomes a specified, reproducible parameter rather than an ambient accident. This preserves determinism and polynomial cost, but invites the criticism that a content-hash order injects arbitrary bias into which nodes win ties, and that the order is a new semantic parameter with no independent justification beyond fixing a non-issue in the materialization layer.
